verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in, in-product AI that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data. The AI-related items describe external assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, and others) reaching Anytype data through the MCP server, Agents Skill, or local API. Those are external tools and developer building blocks, not an in-app capability. Queries and the Graph are deterministic organization features, not AI-generated insights.
